# runpod_network_volume (Resource)

A persistent network storage volume.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "runpod_network_volume" "datasets" {
  name        = "datasets"
  size        = 100
  data_center = "EU-RO-1"
  type        = "HIGH_PERFORMANCE"
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this resource live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_center` (String) Data center to create the volume in. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `name` (String) Human-readable volume name.
- `size` (Number) Storage to allocate in GB, between 10 and 4096. Can grow, never shrink.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Storage tier: STANDARD or HIGH_PERFORMANCE. Defaults to the data center's primary tier. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Volume identifier assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Network volumes are imported by volume id.
terraform import runpod_network_volume.datasets agv6w2qcg7
```
